passage.label: Did We not destroy former peoples; then follow later ones; thus deal criminals; Woe Day deniers; Did We not create you liquid disdained; placed firm lodging; known extent; determined excellent determine; Woe Day deniers; Have We not made earth container living dead; placed lofty firmly set mountains given drink sweet water; Woe Day deniers

arabicExcerpts.text: وَجَعَلۡنَا فِيهَا رَوَٰسِيَ شَٰمِخَٰتٖ وَأَسۡقَيۡنَٰكُم مَّآءٗ فُرَاتٗا

mainSubject.label: Former peoples destroyed and later ones following as the pattern for dealing with criminals — woe that Day to the deniers; creation from a disdained liquid placed in a firm lodging for a known extent, determined by One excellent at determining — woe that Day to the deniers; the earth made a container for living and dead with lofty firmly-set mountains and sweet water provided — woe that Day to the deniers

notes: Wave 11 genuine re-extraction. Boundaries follow the text: P1 closes with the first 'woe to the deniers' refrain after the Day-of-Judgement question (15) before the destruction-and-creation proofs block opens (16); P2 ends with the third 'woe' refrain after the earth-container argument (28) before the punishment-scene command begins (29); P3 runs through the smoke-shadow description, speech prohibition, assembly and planning challenge ending with the sixth 'woe' (40); P4 covers the righteous reward, criminal brief-enjoyment, prayer-refusal and closing Quran-challenge with remaining 'woe' refrains (41-50).
